title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women, one from Campania and one from Lombardy. We keep them in the light with respect and gratitude.

women.name: Greta Astarita
tribute: Greta Astarita, 33, lived in Piano di Sorrento, in Campania, and was a mother to a young boy. She and her family are in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Malnate
tribute: A woman from Malnate, 52, in Lombardy. Her name has not been published, and we respect that.
She was well known in her town for her business and her many activities, and she is in our thoughts.
